description: This file contains functions related to extracting and manipulating calibration data, including functions for reading from various device partitions, patching calibration data, and updating device-specific parameters such as MAC addresses and regulatory domains.

methods.name: caldata_dd
methods.description: Performs a raw data dump from a source to a target using the dd command with specified byte size and offset.

methods.name: caldata_die
methods.description: Outputs an error message and terminates the script.

methods.name: caldata_extract
methods.description: Extracts calibration data from a partition by locating the appropriate mtd device and reading a specified byte range.

methods.name: caldata_extract_ubi
methods.description: Extracts calibration data from a UBI volume in NAND flash.

methods.name: caldata_extract_mmc
methods.description: Extracts calibration data from an MMC partition.

methods.name: caldata_extract_reverse
methods.description: Extracts calibration data in reverse byte order from a partition and writes it to firmware.

methods.name: caldata_from_file
methods.description: Copies calibration data from a file source to the firmware target.

methods.name: caldata_sysfsload_from_file
methods.description: Loads calibration data into a sysfs directory from a file.

methods.name: caldata_valid
methods.description: Validates the calibration data by checking a magic number.

methods.name: caldata_patch_data
methods.description: Patches calibration data or MAC addresses in firmware, with optional checksum updates.

methods.name: ath9k_patch_mac
methods.description: Patches MAC address in firmware for ath9k devices.

methods.name: ath9k_patch_mac_crc
methods.description: Patches MAC address and CRC in firmware for ath9k devices.

methods.name: ath10k_patch_mac
methods.description: Patches MAC address in firmware for ath10k devices.

methods.name: ath11k_patch_mac
methods.description: Patches MAC address in firmware for ath11k devices with specific MAC ID.

methods.name: ath10k_remove_regdomain
methods.description: Removes the regulatory domain information from firmware for ath10k devices.

methods.name: ath11k_remove_regdomain
methods.description: Removes the regulatory domain information from firmware for ath11k devices.

methods.name: ath11k_set_macflag
methods.description: Sets a specific MAC flag in firmware for ath11k devices.
